topic: Getting a Spare Car Key Cut at the Counter

script.title: ONE KEY LESS A DOG
script.scene_zh: 汽車配件店 · 鑰匙櫃臺
script.story_hook: The only spare key is now somewhere in a dog.
script.intro_zh: 唯一的備用鑰匙，現在在狗狗的肚子裡。
script.welcome_en: Hi, today we visit the key counter. Listen for how to ask about price and timing.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，今天我們來到配鑰匙櫃臺。留意問價與問時間的說法。
script.outro: And that's a spare key saved from disaster. Listen once more, out loud.
script.outro_zh: 一把備用鑰匙，就這樣化解了一場危機。再聽一遍，大聲跟著說。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a petite young woman in her early twenties with straight shoulder-length dyed purple hair, silver hoop earrings, an oversized denim jacket over a white tee, ripped black jeans, and worn high-top sneakers
script.char_b_description: a short heavyset older man in his sixties with thinning grey hair combed to the side, a bushy white mustache, safety glasses on his forehead, a navy shop apron over a plaid flannel shirt, and steel-toe boots

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, do you cut car keys at this counter?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ du ju kʌt kɑɹ kiːz æt ðɪs ˈkaʊɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 你好，請問這個櫃臺可以配汽車鑰匙嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We do, spares, replacements, all kinds.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi du spɛɹz ˌɹɪpleɪsˈmɛnts ɔl kaɪndz/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，備用鑰匙、遺失補配，各種都行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, because I just made my spare useless.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt bɪˈkɔz aɪ dʒʌst meɪd maɪ spɛɹ ˈjusləs/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，因為我剛把備用鑰匙弄沒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no, what happened, if you don't mind?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ wʌt ˈhæpənd ɪf ju doʊnt maɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 噢不，方便說說發生什麼事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, my dog swallowed it. Whole.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm maɪ dɑɡ ˈswɑloʊd ɪt hoʊl/
dialogue.zh: 呃，我家狗狗把鑰匙整顆吞了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No way. Is the dog okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ weɪz ɪz ðə dɑɡ oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 不會吧，狗狗沒事吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He's fine, unbothered, honestly pretty proud.
dialogue.phonetic: /hiz faɪn ʌnˈboðɚd ˈɑnəstli ˈpɹɪti praʊd/
dialogue.zh: 牠沒事，毫不在意，甚至有點得意。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, dogs consider key eating a snack.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ dɑɡz kənˈsɪdɚ ki ˈitɪŋ ə snæk/
dialogue.zh: 哈，在狗的眼裡，吃鑰匙等於吃點心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, can you make me a new one?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ kən ju meɪk mi ə nu wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 所以你們可以幫我做一把新的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Absolutely, first, proof the car is yours.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌæbsəˈlutli fɝst pɹuf ðə kɑɹz jɔɹz/
dialogue.zh: 當然可以，首先要證明車子是你的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I brought my registration, right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ brɔt maɪ ˌrɛdʒəsˈtreɪʃən ɹaɪt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 我帶了行車註冊文件，就在這。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, the name matches, we can proceed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt ðə neɪm ˈmætʃəz wi kən pɹəˈsid/
dialogue.zh: 很好，名字對上了，我們可以開始辦理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Relief. Um, how long does cutting take?
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈlif ʌm haʊ lɔŋ dʌz ˈkʌtɪŋ teɪk/
dialogue.zh: 鬆了口氣。呃，鋸一把要多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The metal part, about five minutes flat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈmɛɾəl pɑɹt əˈbaʊt faɪv ˈmɪnəts flæt/
dialogue.zh: 金屬那部分，五分鐘就搞定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That fast? Then we're done, awesome.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt fæst ðɛn wɪɹ dʌn ˈɔsəm/
dialogue.zh: 這麼快？那豈不是馬上就搞定？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow down, now the tricky part: the chip.
dialogue.phonetic: /sloʊ daʊn naʊ ðə ˈtɹɪki pɑɹt ðə tʃɪp/
dialogue.zh: 先別急，接下來是麻煩的部分：晶片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Chip? Like a tiny computer in the key?
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɪp laɪk ə ˈtini kəmˈpjutɚ ɪn ðə ki/
dialogue.zh: 晶片？就像鑰匙裡的小電腦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, your car reads it before starting.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli jɔɹ kɑɹ ɹidz ɪt bɪˈfɔɹ ˈstɑɹtɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，你的車發動前會先讀取它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, mine is fancier than I thought.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ maɪnz ˈfænsiɚ ðæn aɪ θɔt/
dialogue.zh: 噢，沒想到我的車這麼高級。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So, we program the chip, that's twenty more.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wi ˈpɹoʊɡɹæm ðə tʃɪp ðæts ˈtwɛnti mɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 所以我們要寫入晶片，另收二十美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair. Um, and how much for the whole thing?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛɹ ʌm ænd haʊ mʌtʃ fɚ ðə hoʊl θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 合理。嗯，那整套加起來多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Total's seventy-five, key and programming.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtoʊɾəlz ˈsɛvənti faɪv ki ænd ˈpɹoʊɡɹæmɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 總共七十五，鑰匙和寫晶片都含在內。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ouch, my wallet heard that loudly.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊtʃ maɪ ˈwɑlət hɝd ðæt ˈlaʊdli/
dialogue.zh: 嘖，我的錢包聽得清清楚楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Car keys, sadly, are getting expensive.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑɹ kiːz ˈsædli ɑɹ ˈɡɛɾɪŋ ɪkˈspɛnsɪv/
dialogue.zh: 可惜現在汽車鑰匙確實越來越貴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any way to make it a little cheaper?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni weɪ tə meɪk ɪt ə ˈlɪɾəl ˈtʃipɚ/
dialogue.zh: 有沒有什麼辦法可以便宜一點？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You could order a blank key online yourself.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kʊd ˈɔɹdɚ ə blæŋk ki ˌɑnˈlaɪn jɔɹˈsɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 你也可以自己先在網路上買空白鑰匙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Huh, will my car accept a cheap key?
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌ wɪl maɪ kɑɹ əkˈsɛpt ə tʃip ki/
dialogue.zh: 呃，我的車會接受便宜鑰匙嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually yes, some brands are picky, though.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈjuʒuəli jɛs sʌm bɹændz ɑɹ ˈpɪki ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 通常可以，不過有些牌子很挑剔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine's a 2019, is that a picky one?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪnz ə ˈtwɛnti naintɪn ɪz ðæt ə ˈpɪki wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 我的車是 2019 年的，那種會挑剔嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That year's easy, order and bring it in.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt jɪɹz ˈizi ˈɔɹdɚ ænd brɪŋ ɪt ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 那年份很好配，你買來我再幫你處理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, but honestly, I leave town on Friday.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ bət ˈɑnəstli aɪ liv taʊn ɑn ˈfɹaɪdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 好，不過老實說我週五就要出城。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So you need a key by Thursday, then?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ju nid ə ki baɪ ˈθɝzdeɪ ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 所以你想在週四之前拿到鑰匙？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yeah, and one key feels risky already.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛ ænd wʌn ki filz ˈɹɪski ɔlˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 對，而且只有一把鑰匙本來就有點危險。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True. Option one: I make it today, seventy-five.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɹu ˈɑpʃən wʌn aɪ meɪk ɪt təˈdeɪ ˈsɛvənti faɪv/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯。選項一：我今天直接做，七十五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Option two: order the key, ship it here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑpʃən tu ˈɔɹdɚ ðə ki ʃɪp ɪt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 選項二：訂鑰匙寄到你們這裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, blank costs forty, arrives in three days.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt blæŋk kɔsts ˈfɔɹti əˈɹaɪvz ɪn θɹi deɪz/
dialogue.zh: 對，空白鑰匙四十美元，三天後到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three days... that's Wednesday, cutting it close.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɹi deɪz ðæts ˈwɛnzˌdeɪ ˈkʌtɪŋ ɪt kloʊs/
dialogue.zh: 三天……那就是週三，時間好緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is, plus I'd still need to program it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz plʌs aɪd stɪl nid tə ˈpɹoʊɡɹæm ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 是啊，而且到時我還得幫你寫晶片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, waiting might make me miss the trip.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm ˈweɪɾɪŋ maɪt meɪk mi mɪs ðə tɹɪp/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，再等下去，這趟旅行就泡湯了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So today's key saves the Friday drive?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ təˈdeɪz ki seɪvz ðə ˈfɹaɪdeɪ dɹaɪv/
dialogue.zh: 所以今天做鑰匙，就能保住週五出發？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, let's do today, my wallet will recover.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs lɛts du təˈdeɪ maɪ ˈwɑlət wɪl ɹɪˈkʌvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 好，今天就做，我的錢包會挺過來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Brave choice. Quick check, is the car outside?
dialogue.phonetic: /bɹeɪv tʃɔɪs kwɪk tʃɛk ɪz ðə kɑɹ ˌaʊtˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 勇敢的選擇。快速確認一下，車子就在外面嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yeah, parked right by the entrance.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛ pɑɹkt ɹaɪt baɪ ði ˈɛnɪəns/
dialogue.zh: 對，就停在入口旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, I need the car for its key code.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪ nid ðə kɑɹ fɚ ɪts ki koʊd/
dialogue.zh: 很好，我需要從車上查鑰匙碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The code? Um, where would that even be?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə koʊd ʌm wɛɹ wʊd ðæt ˈivən bi/
dialogue.zh: 鑰匙碼？呃，那東西通常在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Driver door edge, tiny sticker, look there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdɹaɪvɚ dɔɹ ɛdʒ ˈtini ˈstɪkɚ lʊk ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 駕駛側門邊，一張小貼紙，就看那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh wow, there it is, eight small letters.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ waʊ ðɛɹ ɪts ɪt ɪz eɪt smɔːl ˈlɛɾɚz/
dialogue.zh: 哇，找到了，是八個小字母。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's exactly what I needed, makes it fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ɪɡˈzæktli wʌt aɪ ˈnidɪd meɪks ɪt fæst/
dialogue.zh: 正是我要的碼，有了它一切都快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So now you cut, program, and I pay?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ naʊ ju kʌt ˈpɹoʊɡɹæm ænd aɪ peɪ/
dialogue.zh: 所以現在你鋸鑰匙、寫晶片，最後我付錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In that order, yes, pay last, like restaurants.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ðæt ˈɔɹdɚ jɛs peɪ læst laɪk ˈɹɛstəɹɑnts/
dialogue.zh: 就是這個順序，錢最後再付，像餐館一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deal. Can I watch you make it?
dialogue.phonetic: /dil kən aɪ wɑtʃ ju meɪk ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 成交。我可以在旁邊看著做嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, stand back, the machine throws metal dust.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ stænd bæk ðə məˈʃin θɹoʊz ˈmɛɾəl dʌst/
dialogue.zh: 可以，站遠一點，機器會噴出金屬屑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Noted, stepping back like it's a fireworks show.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊɾɪd ˈstɛpɪŋ bæk laɪk ɪts ə ˈfaɪɚˌwɜks ʃoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 了解，我退後，像在看煙火秀。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There, done, now onto the little computer part.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛɹ dʌn naʊ ˈɑnˌtu ðə ˈlɪɾəl kəmˈpjutɚ pɑɹt/
dialogue.zh: 好了，這步搞定，接著是小電腦的部分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's already shaped like my lost key, spooky.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ɔlˈrɛdi ʃeɪpt laɪk maɪ lɑst ki ˈspuki/
dialogue.zh: 它已經跟我的那把鑰匙一模一樣，好詭異。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The car knows it now, try the door yourself.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kɑɹ noʊz ɪt naʊ traɪ ðə dɔɹ jɔɹˈsɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 車子已經認得它了，你自己去開門試試。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It opened! Honestly, that felt like magic.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈoʊpənd ˈɑnəstli ðæt fɛlt laɪk ˈmædʒɪk/
dialogue.zh: 打開了！老實說，這感覺像在變魔術。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's my party trick, birthday kids love it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts maɪ ˈpɑɹti trɪk ˈbɝθˌdeɪ kɪdz lʌv ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 這就是我的拿手好戲，生日會上的小朋友都愛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seventy-five well spent, thank you, key magician.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛvənti faɪv wɛl spɛnt θæŋk ju ki məˈdʒɪʃən/
dialogue.zh: 這七十五塊花得值得，謝謝你，鑰匙魔術師。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bye now, and hide that spare from the dog.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ naʊ ænd haɪd ðæt spɛɹ fɹəm ðə dɑɡ/
dialogue.zh: 再見，備用鑰匙記得藏高一點，別再讓狗吃了。

script.youtube_title_en: "My Dog Swallowed It" — Getting a Spare Car Key Cut Today
script.youtube_description:
「我家狗狗把鑰匙整顆吞了」——備用鑰匙沒了，怎麼在配鑰匙櫃臺問清楚？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在汽車配件店的鑰匙櫃臺。

你會聽到：出示行車文件證明車籍、晶片鑰匙與一般鑰匙的差別、寫晶片的額外費用；趕在週五出發前「今天做還是訂購」的兩個選項；還有查鑰匙碼、現場試開門的真實對答。

整段對話保持 A2 初級程度的短句，充滿美國人日常的真實語感：um、well、so、huh、no way。聽完你就會用：How long does cutting take?、Any way to make it a little cheaper?、In that order、Seventy-five well spent。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著念，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"My dog swallowed it" — your only spare key is gone, and the car still needs to start. This 60-line English listening practice happens right at the key-cutting counter of an auto parts store.

You will hear: showing proof of ownership, asking what a chip key is, paying for programming, comparing make-it-today with order-online options, finding the key code sticker on the door, and testing the new key on the spot.

Everything stays at A2 level, with real American rhythm: um, well, so, huh, no way. By the end you'll own lines like How long does cutting take?, Can I watch you make it?, and Seventy-five well spent.

The last chapter is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud with every key cut.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
唯一一把備用鑰匙讓狗吞了，怎麼辦？配一把車鑰匙要多久、多少錢？晶片鑰匙又是什麼新科技？

這一集帶大家走進汽車配件店的鑰匙櫃臺，從證明車籍、解釋晶片、比較選項，一路聽到現場試開門與道別，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🔑 開場句：Um, my dog swallowed it. Whole.
💳 問價位：Fair. Um, and how much for the whole thing?
📦 比選項：Option two: order the key, ship it here?
🚗 試新鑰匙：It opened! Honestly, that felt like magic.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、huh、no way 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著這場鑰匙危機走一趟，下次你的車有任何小毛病，開口就不會卡。

祝你家的狗，永遠對鑰匙沒興趣。
